settings.intro: Quality, affordable heels and bags. Pick your pair, place your order, pay by mobile money, and we deliver.
settings.payNote: Send the exact total and use your order number as the reference. Then send us a screenshot of the payment on WhatsApp. We confirm and dispatch once payment is received.
